saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
🧭 A person, maybe 40s, with thick glasses is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
💧 A woman, maybe 40s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 30s came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
A woman, maybe 30s came back with 549 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
★ IDENTIFIED: Lamb's Quarters. Dusty-green leaves, white powder underneath. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
A person, maybe 40s, with thick glasses was watching. Now they know Lamb's Quarters too.
A person, maybe 40s, with thick glasses brought you a sample. The Journal grows.
Hinehou and Li lingered over the fire together.
Chantal and Jorge lingered over the fire together.
📓 Journal: the man in his 40s taught the person in their 40s, with thick glasses, the army medic Reading Tracks.
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s taught the man in his 60s Steady Hands.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A woman, maybe 40s watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Lamb's Quarters — named and noted.

👀 the person in their 40s, with thick glasses, the army medic was talking about home — then stopped mid-sentence, recalibrated, and said "Denver" just a fraction too deliberately. Whatever home is, it isn't where that sentence started.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 40s, with thick glasses).

👀 "veterinarian, huh?" the man in his 50s, with a missing fingertip, the veterinarian nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no veterinarian would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip).
Pamela Miranda reads the sky: rain tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 40s, with thick glasses will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A man, maybe 40s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 40s, with thick glasses — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Li," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Li." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Li).
"Jorge," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Jorge." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Jorge).
"Desmond," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Desmond." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Desmond).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut says. (Trust too low.)

🌿 A man, maybe 40s checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A man, maybe 40s hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
💧 Li returns with 9L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
Li showed A woman, maybe 40s the Lamb's Quarters — "remember it." Word gets around.

raidLines.text: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (Big Loud, The Paparazzo, Cliffhanger) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (tick, The Understudy, Night Court, The Living Wire) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Understudy, Spool, Hushpuppy, Hushpuppy, Big Big) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — Spool came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.
